description: Search the iOS App Store, look up apps by ID, URL or bundle ID, collect deep customer reviews with developer replies, list a publisher's catalog, or read top charts. No Apple account, cookie, or key required.

appIds.description: Apps to look up or review (mode=lookup/reviews). Accepts numeric App Store IDs, bundle IDs, app URLs, and developer URLs. Separate multiple values with commas or new lines.
appIds.title: App IDs, bundle IDs, or URLs

chartType.description: Top chart to read (mode=charts). Mac charts use the App Store Mac catalog.
chartType.title: Chart

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront. Changes pricing, availability, chart contents, and review language.
country.title: Storefront country

developerId.description: Apple artist ID or developer page URL (mode=developer). For example 281956209 or https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/google/id281956209. Comma-separated values are accepted.
developerId.title: Developer ID or URL

developerName.description: Publisher name to resolve when you do not know the developer ID (mode=developer). The actor searches App Store listings and matches the publisher name.
developerName.title: Developer name

includeDetails.description: Add App Store detail fields such as privacy labels, version history, rating histogram, support URL, and subtitle (app-producing modes). Disable it for the fastest, cheapest search runs.
includeDetails.title: Include rich app details

includeDeveloperResponses.description: Keep developer replies when Apple exposes them (mode=reviews). Replies are available only for apps where the developer actually responded.
includeDeveloperResponses.title: Include developer responses

language.description: Language used for App Store metadata and reviews. Defaults to English (United States).
language.title: Storefront language

maxItems.description: Hard cap on rows pushed per run (1-5000). Applies to apps, chart rows, and reviews combined. For very large review corpora, raise this and set maxReviewsPerApp.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Reviews to collect for each app (1-50000). The deep review route returns 20 per request; RSS enrichment is available for the first 500 reviews when version or helpful-vote data exists.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app

mode.description: What to collect. Search finds apps by keyword, Lookup resolves IDs/URLs, Reviews collects customer feedback, Developer lists a publisher's apps, and Charts reads a top list.
enumTitles: Look up apps by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy. Add an Apify Proxy configuration only if your own network or a future Apple rate limit needs it.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

reviewSort.description: Most recent first, or Apple's most-helpful ordering (mode=reviews).
reviewSort.title: Review order

searchTerms.description: Keywords to search for (mode=search). Each term returns up to 200 ranked apps, and results are de-duplicated across terms.
searchTerms.title: Search terms

startUrls.description: Paste App Store app or developer URLs (mode=lookup/reviews). App URLs resolve to one app; developer URLs expand to that publisher's catalog.
startUrls.title: App Store URLs

title: iOS App Store Deep Reviews & App Intelligence Input
